**What I do next**

I open round 5 as a model-swap round. I will not change the pinned model in C2 directly. A new model is one change, so it gets its own configuration and its own prediction. Then it gets measured against C2 on Sonnet 5.5 under the same tasks and graders.

First I ask you to enter plan mode with a short r05 prompt. Your words go verbatim into `spe/spec/transcripts/2026-10-21-r05.md`. Before I write any number, I will check Anthropic's current model docs. I need the exact dated Sonnet 6 model ID and its price. I will pin the dated ID, not an alias.

**Plan outline: SPE round 5 (Sonnet 6 vs Sonnet 5.5)**

1. Specify (commit `SPE r05 specify`)
   - Save your plan-mode prompt and answers verbatim in `spe/spec/transcripts/2026-10-21-r05.md`.
   - Add an r05 table to `spe/spec/spec.md`:
     - R05-1: Run C2 on Sonnet 6 with every other setting identical to C2. Source: "Sonnet 6 just shipped." Test: config diff shows only the model ID changed.
     - R05-2: Re-run C2 on Sonnet 5.5, pinned, as the baseline arm. Source: decision. Test: r05 C2@5.5 results sit inside the r04 measured bands.
     - R05-3: Keep the judge model fixed at its r04 model, even if it is a Sonnet. Source: decision. Test: the judge ID in the r05 script matches r04. A judge change would confound the model comparison.
     - R05-4: Keep the r04 tasks and graders unchanged. Source: decision. Test: the grader files diff against `spe-r04` is empty.
   - Proposals in the r04 "Proposed for round 5" table: I defer each one to r06 so this round isolates the model effect. I log this as a default in `spe/spec/disagreements.md`. You can override it in plan mode.
   - Open decision for you: whether a Sonnet 6 win replaces C2 as the best config, and what margin counts as a win. My default is that C2@6 must beat C2@5.5 outside both bands on the primary metric with no metric regressing outside its band.

2. Predict (commit `SPE r05 predict: Sonnet 6 vs Sonnet 5.5 on C2`)
   - Columns: C2@5.5 and C2@6. These differ only by the model.
   - C2@5.5: every cell is "same as last round", taken from the r04 measured values in `spe/prediction-log.md`, with the r04 bands.
   - C2@6: start from the C2@5.5 numbers. Move a number only with a written Why. Examples are accuracy on the split cells from r04 failures, tool calls per trial, tokens per trial, and runtime.
   - Every number gets a band and a named grader check. A hit is inside the band.
   - After approval, copy the plan to `spe/plans/r05.md`. Write `spe/predictions/r05.yaml` with the "Saved before the eval ran" header, author "Claude, approved by the user in plan mode", and `same_as_last_round` per number. Commit both before any harness work.

3. Evaluate (commits `SPE r05 evaluate (harness)` and `SPE r05 evaluate (results): <headline>`)
   - Copy `spe/evals/harness/r04-workflow.js` to `r05-workflow.js`. Set `ROUND = 5` once. Add the model ID as a per-config argument.
   - Gates before launch: grader selftest (oracle passes, empty and wrong fail). Regrade r04 results with the r05 graders as a control, which should show no change. Dry run 2 or 3 cells with `args.only`, including one C2@6 cell, to confirm the new model ID resolves.
   - Phases: Trials, Grade (code checks first), Judge (only for what code cannot check), Top-up for split cells up to the cap, failure analysis, and completeness critic.
   - Leak control: trials read only allowed paths. Scan transcripts for reads of `spe/evals/` and `spe/predictions/` and void any trial that peeked.
   - Budget: cap API spend and agent count in the args. Price Sonnet 6 from the verified docs. Skip and log any trial that would cross the cap.
   - Measure accuracy, runtime, tool calls, tokens, and tool errors per completed trial. Rate limits on a new model count as harness errors, not model failures.
   - Cost estimate (unmeasured): r04 spend for C2 times 2 arms, adjusted by the Sonnet 6 price ratio.

4. Learn (commit `SPE r05 learn: ...`, tag `spe-r05`)
   - Fill in `spe/prediction-log.md` with Predicted, Measured, Same as last round, and Verdict. Add "Which Why broke" for each miss, and say plainly if the naive "same as r04" guess beat the moved numbers.
   - Add new failure types to `spe/failures.md`, including any Sonnet 6 specific ones.
   - If C2@6 passes everything, the r06 proposal must include harder tasks or stricter graders.
   - Write the "Proposed for round 6" table with the deferred r04 proposals, plus `spe/predictions/r05-draft.yaml` with `status: draft`. Update `spe/README.md`.
   - Halt and report if a budget cap is hit, a grader breaks, or an answer key leaks. Commits stay local. I do not push.

The answer says it will not change the pinned model in C2 directly. Replacing C2 is listed as an open decision for the user that depends on a Sonnet 6 win "outside both bands." Nothing switches before the eval.

The measured metrics are "accuracy, runtime, tool calls, tokens, and tool errors per completed trial." Cost shows up only as a budget cap and an "unmeasured" overall estimate. Cost per trial is not a metric the plan compares between C2@5.5 and C2@6, so this check is not fully met.
